training.before: Maybe you’ve been trying to comfort your little one for weeks, and the words are all there, but the loving grown-up behind them isn’t, not yet. Some people at that point might try saying sweeter and sweeter things, and then upon that not working, perhaps just “throw the baby out with the bathwater,” and decide reparenting is useless. I’d borrow that grown-up first. Then try again, and see if your little one can tell the difference.

holdouts.source: Physical trauma reactions can persist after the danger has passed, even when you know you're safe. With complex or developmental trauma, direct work on the deepest memory can be overwhelming, so a gradual approach may be enough: Buddhist nun Pema Chodron calls it a “feather touch,” and Peter Levine, the founder of Somatic Experiencing, calls gentle work around the edges “pendulation.” The same limit appears in inner-child therapy: you can know what the younger part needs yet enter the child-state so fully that too little adult perspective remains to provide it.
holdouts.owner_reference_hidden_from_writer:
Physical trauma reactions can continue after the danger is over, even when you know you're safe.

With complex or developmental trauma, going straight for the deepest memory can be overwhelming. Instead of diving off the deep end heroically, take it easy, one step at a time. As Buddhist nun Pema Chodron says, "feather touch" is all it takes to gently open up.  Peter Levine, the founder of Somatic Experiencing, calls this gentle work around the edges, "pendulation."

In inner-child therapy, you can know exactly what the younger part needs and still get pulled so far into the child-state that there isn't enough adult perspective left to give it.

holdouts.source: But here’s the chicken-and-egg problem. What if you’re so far inside the child-state that you can’t become the adult? This is much easier when you can already reach one of those adult roles. Without that, you can sit there trying to say all the loving things while the old critic, numbness, panic, or urge to get away is running the whole thing.

conditions.label: baseline
conditions.exposure: Only source, purpose, preserve-meaning constraints; no teaching examples and no Emulate.

conditions.label: causal-thought
conditions.exposure: Same source + concise actual-problem/experiencer/causal-action composition step; no examples or Emulate.

conditions.label: positive-examples
conditions.exposure: Same source + causal-thought instruction + exactly T-P2 & T-FG literal before/after successful examples; no target-specific hints, no Emulate calls and no hidden reference.

execution.tools: No tools requested; independent temporary cwd and prompt-only inputs; inspect run logs for unexpected tool calls.
eval: Preservation: enumerate forward + reverse unexplained semantic deltas; any missing attribution, risk condition, actor, causal mechanism, certainty or invented example rejects candidate
Cold naturalness + speaker coherence graded by fresh reader blind to condition (secondary; owner reading primary)
Prosody: inspect repeated cadence and what the thought movement does, not count sentence lengths or guess labels
Pangram 4.1 only for candidates passing preservation; max 2 paid checks in this pilot, exact hashes and natural paragraph context if feasible
Compare paired A/B/C per target, not unrelated examples.
execution.promotion_gate: No claim of GPT skill unless at least two different unseen rhetorical jobs obtain owner-approved naturalness, zero semantic misses, and meaningful paragraph/context Human results without Emulate. Two successes merely transferred twice, not permanent model-weight learning.
execution.stop_gate: If treatment regresses both targets or clear preservation defects remain, do not run more same-template retries. Review architecture; save negative result.
execution.controls: Owner-reference and known Pangram outcomes withheld from generators. Reviewer receives anonymized version labels and sources only; critic same context cannot constitute independent evidence.
